name: Current Elemental Dice Cost
description:
If a Cost Increase or Cost Reduction is attached to an Action Card, its current Elemental Dice cost will be adjusted accordingly.
(Effects that reduce the Elemental Dice cost when playing the card do not affect this cost.)
